0022600155.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 15th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-3, on a two-game losing streak and 10th in the East). Indiana beat Brooklyn 136-109 in their last meeting in Brooklyn on October 25, leaving the Nets trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 1-2 in 2025-26. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain).
